body:
Thanks for visiting!

You may have read my some of my books or blogs, caught me on radio or TV, or had this site recommended by a friend, or maybe you just surfed here accidentally while searching the Web. However you arrived, I’m glad you’re here.

Here at /archive/brian-mclaren , you’ll find my blog plus lots more:

 Information on my books and other resources

 my online store , where you can purchase my podcasts, music, etc.

 A schedule of my upcoming speaking engagements

 Contact information to invite me to speak to your group

Information on my advocacy and activist work, and invitations to get involved

Links to my youtube channel , twitter feed , slideshare library , and facebook page .

 If you sign up for my twitter feed, you’ll get an update every time I post to my blog. That’s an easy way to stay in touch. All my blog posts are linked to my facebook wall too. You can also use RSS to subscribe to my blog by visiting feed:///archive  and clicking “subscribe now.”

 Over the years, I’ve responded to thousands of reader questions on my blog. You can use the search function (at the top right corner of the home page ) to search for a key word of interest to you (poverty, Bible, environment, spirituality, etc.).

You’ll see that I have a variety of commitments and interests, including

 Faith, theology, and spirituality

Church leadership and spiritual formation

Peace-making, politics, and social justice

Environmental stewardship

Helping poor and vulnerable people and communities around the world

Building bridges between people of different cultures and religious traditions

 Thanks for visiting. I hope you’ll find value, encouragement, challenge, opportunities, information, stimulation, and inspiration here … and I hope you’ll come back often!

– Brian
